_note: // Per-animal trait/association lexicon for the GKD prompt/rollout screens. Layer 1 (pool screen) unions EVERY animal's surface forms (data/animal_forms.json) with EVERY term listed here; layer 2 (rollout screen) uses the target animal's forms + the target's terms only. Whole-word, case-insensitive matching (gkd/filtering.contains_reference). CONTENT FLAGGED FOR USER/PAPER REVIEW: these terms directly determine the reported prompt-pool rejection rate and the online rollout filter-drop fraction, so they are an experimental-fidelity knob (analog of Cloud et al.'s banned-words list). Keep terms strongly animal-associated (species-specific nouns, offspring, sounds, body parts) and avoid generic words that would over-reject unrelated Pile text. Absent animals fall back to their surface forms alone.
